definitions.explanation: goods or merchandise transported by ship

examples.japanese: {船荷|ふなに}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|お}ろす→下ろす：02029_orosu⟧⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: The work of unloading the ship's cargo began.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{船荷|ふなに}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{流|なが}された→流す：01968_nagasu⟧。
examples.english: The ship's cargo was swept into the sea by the typhoon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{港|みなと}→港：01512_minato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{外国|がいこく}→外国：02868_gaikoku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{船荷|ふなに}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{積|つ}んだ→積む：02294_tsumu⟧⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧⟦{貨物船|かもつせん}→貨物船：22204_kamotsusen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{何隻|なんせき}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{停泊|ていはく}→停泊：20272_teihaku⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Several large cargo ships loaded with freight from abroad were anchored in the harbor.

notes:
Specifically refers to cargo or goods transported by ship, as opposed to general freight. The compound combines {船|ふな} (ship) with ⟦{荷|に}→荷：28294_ni⟧ (load/cargo). Japan's island geography makes maritime cargo historically and economically important.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {船荷|ふなに}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{積|つ}む→積む：02294_tsumu⟧: to load ship cargo
- {船荷|ふなに}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|お}ろす→下ろす：02029_orosu⟧: to unload ship cargo
- {船荷|ふなに}{証券|しょうけん}: bill of lading (B/L)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{貨物|かもつ}→貨物：00165_kamotsu⟧: cargo/freight — general term not limited to ships
- ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧: luggage/baggage — personal belongings rather than commercial cargo
- {積荷|つみに}: loaded cargo — emphasizes the cargo as loaded onto a vehicle or vessel
